chapters.intro: Fire, grass and mud: how every world on Gilly SMP starts. You can't use a furnace yet, so the first goal is a Mud Kiln.
Copper opens three paths: archaeology, two-in-one tools, and better furnaces.
The Blast Furnace unlocks the real metals. Each one has its own built-in properties, and alloys are smithed onto a base metal.
With a Smithing Table you upgrade base-metal equipment with an alloy. Each advancement needs any one piece of that alloy's equipment.
Both steps follow from finding diamonds.
Food in The survival rework is about effects, not hunger. Cooking an ingredient reveals its hidden effect.
In The survival rework, villages are built, not found. Obols are the currency, and you invite villagers in yourself.
Estus, warding charms, divine relics and the four Cantos, which each reward Crystal Hearts.
A separate tab that opens when you first enter the Nether. On Gilly SMP the Nether portal is closed for now and will open in a later stage.
A separate tab that opens when you first enter the End. On Gilly SMP the End is closed for now and will open in a later stage.

advs.goal: Automatic. You get it the moment you join. It opens the Tutorial tab.

advs.h: Light Kindling using Tinder or a Flint Firestarter
advs.goal: Use a Fire Starter (flint and steel) on a placed Kindling block (a campfire).

advs.h: Use a Hoe to harvest Grass and dry it on a Campfire
advs.goal: Have Short Dry Grass or Tall Dry Grass in your inventory.
advs.tip: Harvest grass with a hoe, then cook it on a lit Kindling.

advs.h: Construct a Kiln made from Packed Mud and Mudbricks
advs.goal: Have a Mud Kiln in your inventory.
advs.tip: Crafted from Packed Mud and Mud Bricks.

advs.h: Use a Mud Kiln to Smelt Copper
advs.goal: Have a Copper Ingot in your inventory.
advs.tip: Smelt raw copper in the Mud Kiln.

advs.h: Craft a Brush
advs.goal: Craft a Brush.

advs.h: Find a Clay Fetish by searching abandoned Sites
advs.goal: Have a Clay Fetish in your inventory (either the cheerful or the mournful one).
advs.tip: Brush suspicious sand and gravel at ruins and other abandoned sites.

advs.h: Mattocks and Dolabras work as two tools in one but mine slower than their base tools
advs.goal: Craft any Mattock or Dolabra from copper, iron or diamond.

advs.h: Kilns excel at processing Earthen Materials
advs.goal: Have Smooth Stone in your inventory.
advs.tip: Cook stone in a Kiln.

advs.h: Blast Furnaces burn hotter than Kilns, able to melt more durable Metals
advs.goal: Have a Blast Furnace in your inventory.

advs.h: Iron has no Intrinsic Properties and can only Host Steel
advs.goal: Have an Iron Ingot in your inventory.

advs.h: Craft Carbon-Rich Iron with Iron and a Coal Block
advs.goal: Have Carbon-Rich Iron in your inventory.
advs.tip: Crafted from 4 Iron Ingots and 1 Block of Coal.

advs.h: Made by blasting Carbon-Rich Iron, Steel grants Iron Equipment Knockback and greatly increased Durability
advs.goal: Have a Steel Alloy in your inventory.
advs.tip: Smelt Carbon-Rich Iron in the Blast Furnace.

advs.h: Anvils made from Steel can repair Any Equipment with its corresponding Base-Metal Ingot forever
advs.goal: Have an Anvil in your inventory.

advs.h: Smithing Tables allow you to modify Base-Metal tools using Alloys
advs.goal: Have a Smithing Table in your inventory.

advs.h: Gold has Fortune and Looting Intrinsics
advs.goal: Have a Gold Ingot in your inventory.

advs.h: Shakudo grants Copper Equipment Silk Touch and Cleansing Properties
advs.goal: Have a Shakudo Alloy in your inventory.

advs.h: Adamant grants the wielder a Divine Constitution
advs.goal: Have an Adamant Alloy in your inventory.

advs.h: Silver, a once-common Apotropaic Metal is found most commonly in Mountains. Most deposits are now harboured in Abbeys
advs.goal: Have Raw Silver or Silver Bullion in your inventory.
advs.tip: Mountains and Abbeys.

advs.h: Hepatizon grants Copper Equipment unrivaled Speed
advs.goal: Have a Hepatizon Alloy in your inventory.

advs.h: Electrum enhances the Fortune and Looting Properties of Gold but only Diamond can host the Alloy
advs.goal: Have an Electrum Alloy in your inventory.

advs.h: Diamonds have no Intrinsics but are capable of Hosting Electrum and Adamant
advs.goal: Have a Diamond in your inventory.

advs.h: Smith a piece of Steel Equipment from Iron with Steel Alloy
advs.goal: Smith any Steel tool, weapon, armour piece or shears (Iron item + Steel Alloy).

advs.h: Smith a piece of Hepatizon Equipment from Copper with Hepatizon Alloy
advs.goal: Smith any Hepatizon tool, weapon or armour piece (Copper item + Hepatizon Alloy).

advs.h: Smith a piece of Shakudo Equipment from Copper with Shakudo Alloy
advs.goal: Smith any Shakudo tool, weapon or armour piece (Copper item + Shakudo Alloy).

advs.h: Smith a piece of Electrum Equipment from Diamond with Electrum Alloy
advs.goal: Smith any Electrum tool, weapon or armour piece (Diamond item + Electrum Alloy).

advs.h: Smith a piece of Adamant Equipment from Diamond with Adamant Alloy
advs.goal: Smith any Adamant tool, weapon or armour piece (Diamond item + Adamant Alloy).

advs.h: Smithing Upgrades are used to Modify and Upgrade Mattocks and Dolabras
advs.goal: Have a Smithing Upgrade template in your inventory.

advs.h: Smith a Mattock or Dolabra into its alloyed form
advs.goal: Smith a Mattock or Dolabra into its Steel, Shakudo or Electrum version.

advs.h: Descend into Hell
advs.goal: Go through a Nether portal.
advs.tip: The Nether is closed on Gilly SMP for now. It opens in a later stage.

advs.h: Their Time is Near
advs.goal: Stand inside a Stronghold.

advs.h: Reveal the hidden aspect of a Food by cooking it on a Campfire or an Oven
advs.goal: Have any one of these in your inventory: Grilled Melon, Steamed Carrots, Baked Apple, Grilled Tomatoes, Glow Berry Mash, Dried Kelp, Sweet Berry Mash, Honey Ginger Tea, Chocolate, Baked Pumpkin, Braised Toadstool.
advs.tip: Cook the raw ingredient on a Kindling or in an Oven.

advs.h: Cook a secret Ingredient
advs.goal: Have one of the 4 secret cooked ingredients in your inventory.
advs.tip: Spoiler: Steamed Golden Carrots, Baked Golden Apple, Braised Crimson Fungus, Braised Warped Fungus.

advs.h: Cook a secret Meal
advs.goal: Craft one of the 11 secret meals.
advs.tip: Spoiler: Golden Carrot Cupcake, Golden Pickled Carrots, Golden Apple Empanada, Canned Golden Apples, Pickled Warped or Crimson Fungus, Warped or Crimson Stroganoff, Sweet Berry Toast, Warped Pizza, Gnocchi.

advs.h: Construct an Oven from Bricks and Iron
advs.goal: Have an Oven in your inventory.

advs.h: Make a Ceramic Bowl from Bricks
advs.goal: Have a Bowl in your inventory.

advs.h: Make Pumpkin Curry
advs.goal: Cook Pumpkin Curry in an Oven.

advs.h: Make Green Curry
advs.goal: Cook Green Curry in an Oven.

advs.h: Make Japanese Curry
advs.goal: Cook Japanese Curry in an Oven.

advs.h: Make Paneer Makhani. All Foods have viable Vegetarian Options
advs.goal: Cook Paneer Makhani in an Oven.

advs.h: Make Ramen
advs.goal: Cook Ramen in an Oven.

advs.h: Preserve a food to boost its flavour profile
advs.goal: Craft any one preserved food (pickles, jams, canned fruit or mead).

advs.h: Preserve Everything!
advs.goal: Craft all 15 preserved foods.
advs.tip: Sun-dried Tomatoes, Pickled Carrots, Golden Pickled Carrots, Canned Apples, Canned Golden Apples, Glow Berry Jam, Rind Jam, Sweet Berry Jam, Pumpkin Jam, Pickled Potatoes, Pickled Mushrooms, Pickled Toadstools, Pickled Warped Fungus, Pickled Crimson Fungus, Mead.

advs.h: Obtain an Obol
advs.goal: Have an Obol in your inventory.
advs.tip: Pots, fishing treasure, some mobs, and advancement rewards.

advs.h: Use a Beacon Kindling to signal a Wandering Trader
advs.goal: Use a Beacon Kindling on a block.
advs.tip: Crafted from an Obol, a Kindling and a Hay Bale. It calls a Wandering Trader.

advs.h: Cover the Relocation costs for an Asylum Seeker, and make a home for them here
advs.goal: Buy an Asylum Seeker from a trader.
advs.tip: Use it on the ground to bring a new villager to your village.

advs.h: Sell caught fish to a Fisherman
advs.goal: Trade with a Fisherman villager and get an Obol for your fish.

advs.h: Trade with (almost) every profession
advs.goal: Trade at least once with each of these 12 professions: Armorer, Butcher, Cartographer, Cleric, Farmer, Fisherman, Fletcher, Leatherworker, Librarian, Mason, Shepherd, Toolsmith.

advs.t: No More Fish in the Sea
advs.h: Catch Everything!
advs.goal: Catch all 47 fish listed in the Angler's Almanac with a fishing rod.
advs.tip: Fish vary by biome and water temperature.

advs.h: Commit great evil
advs.goal: Kill a villager or a Wandering Trader. Please don't! It's listed only so you know what it is.

advs.h: It Radiates Holy Power. It kind of smells like Curry... maybe Cinnamon?
advs.goal: Have Estus Ash in your inventory.
advs.tip: Skeletons, witches, dungeon chests and fishing junk.

advs.h: Holding a Lapis Nazar will Ward the Dead. It can also be attached to some Equipment
advs.goal: Craft a Lapis Nazar.
advs.tip: Lapis Lazuli, White Dye and Estus Ash.

advs.h: Affix a Nazar to an Iron Sword in a Smithing Table
advs.goal: Smith a Nazar onto an Iron Sword at a Smithing Table.

advs.h: Affix a Nazar to an Iron Sword inlaid with Silver in a Smithing Table
advs.goal: Smith a Nazar onto a silver-inlaid Iron Sword at a Smithing Table.

advs.h: Affix a Nazar to a Shield inlaid with Silver in a Smithing Table
advs.goal: Smith a Nazar onto a silver-inlaid Shield at a Smithing Table.

advs.h: A Relic only obtained by breaking Spawners or vanquishing powerful Forces
advs.goal: Have a Pith in your inventory.
advs.tip: Break spawners, or defeat strong foes such as Evokers, Piglin Brutes and Elder Guardians.

advs.h: Crystal Hearts impart a piece of divinity onto Gods who devour them. Though mortals were only able to use their Undying properties.
advs.goal: Have a Crystal Heart in your inventory.
advs.tip: Crafted from 8 Diamonds around 1 Pith.

advs.h: Defeat the Sea God
advs.goal: Have an Opal in your inventory.
advs.tip: Dropped by an Elder Guardian (Ocean Monument).

advs.h: Pillage the Remnants of Pandaemonium
advs.goal: Have a Ruby in your inventory.
advs.tip: Bastion Remnant chests (Nether).

advs.h: Exhume the Pilgrim's Trails
advs.goal: Have an Amber in your inventory.
advs.tip: Brush suspicious blocks in Trail Ruins.

advs.h: Raid Tartarus
advs.goal: Have a Topaz in your inventory.
advs.tip: Ancient City chests (deep dark).

advs.goal: Automatic when you first enter the Nether.

advs.h: Flesh from Long-Dead Gods
advs.goal: Have Ancient Debris or Adamant Scrap in your inventory.

advs.h: Synthesize Benzene: a Chemical Reagent Forbidden by the Old Laws
advs.goal: Have Benzene in your inventory.
advs.tip: Crafted from a Glass Bottle, 3 Nether Wart and Gunpowder.

advs.h: Tether Raw Estus into a Stable Form
advs.goal: Craft Stabilised Estus.
advs.tip: Estus Ash, Benzene and an Ender Pearl.

advs.h: Craft a Hell-Bound Book
advs.goal: Craft a Hell-Bound Book.
advs.tip: Benzene, Stabilised Estus and a Book.

advs.h: Steal Prayers from a long-dead God
advs.goal: Craft any one Blessing book.

advs.h: Steal every prayer from every once-god
advs.goal: Craft all 17 Blessings.
advs.tip: Aeolus (Wind Burst, Anemos), Arachnae (Bane of Arthropods), Clement (Traversal), Daedalus (Efficiency, Unbreaking), Demeter (Frost Walker, Frost Protection), Eros (Silk Touch), God-King (Channeling, Smite), Hyacinthus (Zephyr), Icarus (Feather Falling), Lu Ban (Mending), Man (Warding), Midas (Looting, Fortune), Paris (Infinity), Prometheus (Unbreaking), Will (Reach), Yama (Flame, Fire Aspect, Fire Protection), Yamm (Depth Strider, Riptide, Aqua Affinity, Respiration).

advs.h: Construct a Warding Stone
advs.goal: Craft a Warding Stone.
advs.tip: Chiseled Stone Bricks, Lapis Nazars and Stabilised Estus.

advs.h: Fail to clear the Wither effect before time runs out
advs.goal: You get this if the Wither effect runs out before you cure it, which costs you a heart. Avoid it.
Automatic when you first enter the End.

advs.h: Defile the Dead God's Dream
advs.goal: Kill the Ender Dragon.
advs.tip: The first kill on the server also stops hostile mobs from spawning on the surface.

advs.h: Seize the work of Daedalus
advs.goal: Have an Elytra in your inventory.
advs.tip: End Ships in End Cities.

advs.h: Smith Hepatizon Elytra
advs.goal: Smith Hepatizon Elytra at a Smithing Table.

advs.h: Smith Shakudo Elytra
advs.goal: Smith Shakudo Elytra at a Smithing Table.
